name: fare-snapshot-audit
title: Fare Snapshot Audit
problem: Can a fare model use only the information available at quote time and recognize when a quote is stale?
limitations: The original stationary simulation has 2,400 quotes over 160 days: 1,500 training, 300 validation and 600 test quotes, split by time. Route, lead time, departure seasonality and weekend status are known at quote time. paid_fare is a later label. post_booking_fare is a separately named intentionally leaked diagnostic prohibited for serving. Quotes expire after five fixture-time units. Values are fictional fare units, not real travel prices. No booking API, consumer advice, causal pricing effect or deployment is implied.
